purpose: Evaluate whether one exact agent/provider/model identity can distinguish runtime proof states without being trusted to certify itself.

steps.action: verify suite identity, version, exact candidate identity, and freshness binding before evaluation
present each synthetic case independently and require exactly one terminal classification plus proof level; do not expose expected answers
compare returned classifications with the fixture suite deterministically; model explanation is non-authoritative
require all cases exact with zero misses for runtime-proof-discipline/v1
record pass or fail, per-case mismatches, evaluated identity, suite version, timestamp, and proof ceiling in agent-admission-eval-result.json
grant runtime-proof-discipline-pass only on an exact pass; otherwise leave the identity static-build-only

guardrails: The candidate does not decide whether it passed.
A persuasive explanation cannot override an incorrect classification.
A prior model version, provider route, endpoint class, or alias cannot satisfy the current exact identity.
A failed suite never grants live-runtime eligibility by fallback.
proofCeiling: Synthetic proof-discipline admission for one exact execution identity only; no live provider quality or application behavior proof.
